seo.title: Ladakh Multisport — 12 Days in Zanskar and Leh | Adventure Access
seo.description: Twelve days from Delhi to Zanskar and Leh, with a culture track and an adventure track every day. From $8,589, double occupancy.

hero.title: Ladakh
hero.subtitle: Twelve days in Zanskar and Leh, with two ways to spend every day and one table to share every evening

intro.label: The Journey
intro.heading: Two Tracks, One Group
paragraphs: The culture in Zanskar has stayed mostly unchanged for a thousand years. This journey spends much of its time with Ladakhi people and in local homes, a look at Himalayan mountain life as it was hundreds of years ago. Time in Leh, the busy capital of Ladakh, and in New Delhi adds the range that makes India such a colorful country.

Every day offers two paths: one rooted in cultural immersion, the other in high adventure. Families and friends of different ages and interests travel together, take different adventures by day, and come back together in the evening with stories from the same landscape. Our local specialists handle everything from airport pickup to drop-off.

dayTypes.label: How the Days Work
dayTypes.heading: Choose Your Track, Day by Day
dayTypes.lede: Before the trip you pick the experiences that suit you. On the road you can change most of them to match your energy and the group. We brief you on the options as we prepare and travel together.

cards.title: Cultural Immersion
cards.body: Workshops with makers, village walks, monasteries, home kitchens and festivals of the everyday. Quiet mornings and long conversations with the people who live here.

cards.title: High Adventure
cards.body: Shuttle-supported mountain biking on trails not built for bikes, big hikes over high passes, a river cable crossing and a rafting day on the Zanskar. For experienced riders and strong hikers.

cards.title: Together
cards.body: The long drives, the camp at Sheela Phu, shared meals and the evenings. Both tracks reunite every night.

chapters.label: The Journey in Chapters
chapters.heading: Twelve Days, Two Ways
chapters.lede: Each day shows both tracks. You choose before the trip and can switch most days on the road.

groups.title: Nimmu — A Soft Landing in the Sham Valley
prose: After hours, or even days, of travel, the flight from Delhi to Leh drops you into crisp, clear air. The first days are designed for a soft arrival: settle into the story of a Ladakhi heritage home, stretch your legs, and let your breathing tune to the altitude.

days.label: Day 1
days.text: Fly Delhi to Leh and drive to Nimmu House, one of our closest partner properties. A personal tour through sunlit courtyards, carved rooms and the family's royal history, then a nourishing garden supper.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: A hands-on pottery class with a Nimmu artisan, a village walk with a local friend along the fields, shrines and water channels, and snack shopping at a family shop for the days in Zanskar.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: Morning yoga in the loft at Nimmu, then a shuttle to the Lamayuru old road for a playful, mostly downhill ride along the retired cliffside highway, with optional freeride features.

groups.title: Into Zanskar — Zangla, Sheela Phu and Nerak
prose: A long drive brings everyone together into Zanskar, one of the least touched valleys in the region. Four days of village classrooms, hilltop ruins, a camp where three valleys meet, and yak paths that seem made for riding.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Tea with the teachers at Chomo Gonpa School, which your trip helps support, then a guided wander through Khar Kongma Palace. When schedules allow, meet the prince who helps care for it.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: Tea at the school and the palace visit, then repeatable shuttle laps on a short, twisting descent beneath the royal walls.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Milk the animals with our Zangla hosts and learn to make khambir bread. A visit near Sheela Falls, a picnic under the trees, then a gentle hike up to camp.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: The Malai Khartse hike, with river crossings, scree slopes, rock scrambles and some foraging, then on to the Sheela Phu campsite.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Murals and quiet rituals at Stongdae Monastery, then a Zangla dance lesson with musicians and neighbors back at the homestay.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: The biggest hike of the trip, from Sheela Phu over a high pass on a rarely used trail to the village of Kumik. Our team manages pacing, water, snacks and pickup.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Drive to Nerak and climb by 4WD to a viewpoint above the village. Forage juniper along the ridgelines, then chai by the village stream and pond.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: An optional traditional cable crossing of the Zanskar, with modern harnesses, then the Nerak MTB line down freeride slopes and faint yak trails, with shuttle laps if your legs agree.

groups.overnight: Village homestays · one night camping at Sheela Phu

groups.title: Metal and River — Back to Nimmu
prose: Craft and river carry the day. One track works beside hearth and anvil, the other rides the Zanskar River through its deep canyon.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Family metal workshops in Chilling, where copper and silver become ritual objects and everyday vessels, and you try the process yourself. When roads allow, an optional visit to Sumda Chun Monastery or the abandoned village above Nimmu.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: Rafting the Zanskar from near Nerak to Nimmu with a professional crew, support boats and a riverbank lunch.

groups.title: Leh — Threads, Trails and Royal Walls
prose: Leh, the capital of Ladakh, feels like an overgrown village with busy markets and great food. After Zanskar it can feel like a metropolis.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: A half-day fiber experience with a master of Ladakh's wool textiles, then rest with tea in the hotel garden and optional evening shopping.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: Flow and jump lines at the Disko Valley trails with the crew who built them, or the Gyamtsa La hike for a high, wind-washed view of the valley.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: The Central Asian Museum, an open day for shopping with or without a guide, and an optional sunset walk to Shanti Stupa.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: Climb to Leh Palace and Tsemo Gonpa by stepped paths and an overhanging walkway, then the optional Shanti Stupa sunset walk.

groups.title: Delhi — Spice, Print and a Courtyard Feast
prose: A comfortable hotel and a burst of city life to finish. Everyone gathers for dinner in a restored haveli before the last day.

days.label: Day 10

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Fly to Delhi. An optional afternoon at Gurudwara Bangla Sahib, helping in the langar kitchen that feeds thousands.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: Fly to Delhi. A guided spice market walk through Khari Baoli and up to the rooftops above Old Delhi.

days.text: Evening: Dharampura dinner with the whole group.

tracks.name: Culture
tracks.text: Block printing at the Khushbu studio, where you print your own piece, and an optional visit to Humayun's Tomb.

tracks.name: Adventure
tracks.text: An early-morning bike tour with our Nizamuddin partners, block printing with the group, and a Delhi street food walk in the evening.

days.label: Day 12
days.text: Fly home, or ask us to build an extension to Udaipur, Agra or elsewhere in Asia.

pullQuote: Different adventures by day, the same landscape every evening.

highlights.title: Khar Kongma Palace
highlights.body: A palace above the village where our local friends open doors and give context, and the adventure track rides laps beneath the walls.
highlights.imageAlt: Mountain biker cornering on scree below Zangla's royal palace

highlights.title: Life with Our Hosts
highlights.body: Milking the animals, a khambir bread lesson and a dance lesson with neighbors. Long friendships make these feel like visits, not performances.
highlights.imageAlt: Khambir bread lesson with our hosts in Zangla

highlights.title: The Nerak Line
highlights.body: A seldom-ridden descent through freeride slopes and faint yak trails, reached by 4WD from high above the village.
highlights.imageAlt: Rider dropping into the high line above Nerak village

goodToKnow.label: Good to Know
goodToKnow.heading: Before You Go
goodToKnow.lede: A few things that shape how this trip runs.

cards.title: Altitude
cards.body: Altitudes push 16,000 feet, so we ease into activity. What can feel like unnecessary slowness is a proven way to keep you from exhausting yourself on day two and missing the rest of the trip.

cards.title: The adventure track
cards.body: Riding in Zanskar is on trails that were not built for bikes, or on no trail at all: yak paths, steep descents, scree and rocky technical terrain. It is not for beginners.

cards.title: Water and the land
cards.body: Water is life in Ladakh. Instead of hundreds of plastic bottles, we provide a more sustainable way to keep you supplied with clean water, and we take our cues from local partners on where and how we ride.

cards.title: Where your money goes
cards.body: We give 3% of general revenue to sponsor local schools in Zanskar, so children there can attend school.

cards.title: Living in India?
cards.body: Reach out to info@adventure-access.com for a modified itinerary and pricing for residents.

stays.label: Where You'll Stay
stays.heading: Homes, Hotels and One Night Under the Stars
paragraphs: In Leh we prefer 3–4 star places run by hospitable owners over glossy hotels with poor service. Most villages have no hotels, so you stay in homestays, some rustic and some with more comforts. Nimmu House and The Oberoi in Delhi are the 5-star stays of the journey.
